text: DSH Studio（DSH 桌面与 Web 工作台）：把 DeepSeek Harness 的对话和开发工具放进同一个本地项目环境。它通过 Cordis bundle 组合桌面宿主、项目工作区、侧栏、能力 API 和插件市场。主要功能包括项目与 worktree 导航、文件浏览和预览、项目终端、Git Review，以及插件浏览与安装。适合希望在一个 DSH 界面里管理代码和会话的开发者。运行桌面版或 Web 版需要安装对应发行包；代码没有要求额外的模型 API Key。

DSH Studio is a desktop and web workbench for DSH. Its bundle adds project workspaces, a sidebar, capability routes, and a plugin marketplace. Browse files, run terminals, and review Git changes in one place. Install a desktop or web release; no extra model API key is required.

怎么让 DSH 桌面版把自己的运行环境信息提供给其他插件？
我想要一个能在桌面和浏览器发行形态使用的 DSH 工作区。
I want a DSH workspace with project files, a terminal, and Git review together.
Can I organize my DSH work by project, worktree, and session?
I need a graphical way to browse and manage DSH plugins.
I want to inspect project files without leaving my DSH conversation.
DSH Studio 的功能「项目工作区」：bundle 将工作区、侧栏与桌面组件加入 DSH。左侧导航组织项目、worktree 与会话，方便切换当前开发上下文。
DSH Studio 的功能「本地能力 API」：能力插件通过 DSH WebServer 提供项目与会话范围的 API、文件媒体和预览路由，并挂载终端推送通道。
DSH Studio 的功能「插件市场」：桌面宿主启动 marketplace 管理器，插件市场组件向 DSH 发布市场能力，可用于浏览和管理插件来源。
DSH Studio 的功能「项目文件与终端」：侧栏客户端通过能力服务访问宿主提供的文件、工作区和终端功能，供用户在项目内查看文件或使用 PTY。
DSH Studio 的功能「桌面运行时信息」：Host 插件发布桌面平台、profile、版本和应用数据目录等 capability，并向系统提示注入桌面运行环境说明。

@dsh-studio/desktop README · Introduction：DSH Studio is built on the DeepSeek Harness runtime. It brings AI agents, workspaces, local development tools, and the plugin ecosystem into one installable Desktop / Web workbench. Model services still run in the cloud on demand; projects, sessions, terminals, files, Git review, browser state, and plugin state are all organized by one local workspace.

@dsh-studio/desktop README · Key features：
🗂️ Multi-project workspace
Project → Worktree → Session tree with groups, aliases, and automatic project icon detection.		 🧰 All-in-one tool area
Project-scoped PTY, file browsing and preview, browser, and subagent tools — no window switching.
🔍 Git review
Staged / unstaged / untracked sections, commit history, commit file trees, and line-level review targets.		 🤖 Smart commit
Generate commit messages from current changes in one click, with configurable model and reasoning effort.
🖥️ Desktop + Web parity
Same runtime, Profiles, plugins, and data boundaries; Desktop adds a native window and PTY.		 🧩 Plugin marketplace
Browse and install plugins from multiple sources with preview, approval, source locking, and restore.

@dsh-studio/desktop README · Interface preview：

🗂️ Project tree with automatic icons

The left rail organizes context in a Project → Worktree → Session tree. Each project's icon is automatically detected from static assets inside the project — it first reads the icon field declared in package.json, then searches for PNG files in the project, and can also pull from the project homepage favicon or the Git provider avatar — no manual configuration needed.

@dsh-studio/desktop README · Interface preview：If automatic detection misses, right-click the project to pick a built-in icon or upload a custom PNG. Multiple projects, branches, groups, aliases, search, and view state are all persisted.

The terminal opens as a center tab: native PTY, unified shell resolution, project-scoped sessions, streaming output, and replay. Conversation and browser tabs stay in the tab bar for instant switching.

Source launches via `pnpm start` / `pnpm dev` use `~/.dsh-studio-dev` instead, so a packaged app and a verification instance can run side by side. @dsh-studio/desktop README · What this project is built on：| Area | Source and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| DSH runtime | Runs on a pinned runtime from [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) |
| Project source | Continued development from [hust-open-atom-club/oh-dsh](https://github.com/hust-open-atom-club/oh-dsh) |

| Right-rail client/UI | Not a verbatim copy of the upstream UI; DSH Studio owns the file, Git review, Center Surface, project scope, plugin registration, and desktop layout implementations |
| Diff / terminal references | Public implementations and algorithms from [pierre](https://github.com/pierrecomputer/pierre) and [orca](https://github.com/stablyai/orca), with attribution preserved |
